description: There`s one, and here`s one. Look, there`s one over there too! There`s such a mark everywhere Buurin has been at. In order to reveal the truth behind the family emblem of the Mushanokouji family, Ton-chan and I head for Kyoto again! What is the new monster attacked in the cellar? And what kind of a person is Takuma-senpai`s ancestor?
